title: One small behaviour
summary: A unit is a small piece of behaviour, often a function. Test what it returns for a clear input.
introduction: A unit is a small piece of behaviour, often a function. Test what it returns for a clear input. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A unit is a small piece of behaviour, often a function. Test what it returns for a clear input.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: These examples use console.log so they run here. In a real project, a test runner collects tests and reports failures for you.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Unit Testing. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.
The result is true. This test checks doubling four.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a test for doubling zero.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not test several unrelated functions in one unclear check.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
